diversity: Unavailable for a singleton heldout portfolio.
feedback_boundary: Describe observed image strengths and problems; no geometry or scripted drawing answer supplied.
limitations: Evaluator sees the subject and arm path.
Subjective model visual review, no human evaluation or authenticated independent oracle.
Single heldout subject cannot establish generalization.

metrics.composition: Canvas balance, spacing, legibility and use of the frame.
metrics.spatial_coherence: Visible parts relate consistently as an object or scene; overlaps and connections are interpretable.
metrics.subject_recognition: Recognizability of requested subject from actual pixels, with ambiguity recorded.

satisfactory_rule: All three observed metric scores at least 3; this remains a host-reported judgment.

scale.2: Partly successful with substantial ambiguity or conflicts
scale.3: Mostly successful with minor visible problems
